stage: Palimpsest-CI2 — Delegated Completion Evidence & Qualification Continuity

redReproduction.rootCause: makeMutatingAttemptService.settle observed the world, enforced scope and exported the commit, but never derived or executed the Completion Contract. Evidence becomes durable only through an EVIDENCE_ADDED event built by ProjectController, and src/work/ may not import the controller (firewall work-not-host).

ci1AndCi2.note: five CI1 files plus seven CI2 files, run together at the Code Freeze

finishAndGateRegression.note: lean_finish, lean_completion_contract, gate_tool, gate_dsl, lean_governance, evidence_graph, acceptance, y_evidence_authority, w_revision_safe, lean_settlement_closure, lean_work_delegation_transport, lean_d2_live_composition, lean_promotion_readiness, lean_speculative_authority, lean_d5d_result_continuation_service

broadNonGate.selection: every recursive test/**/*.test.ts minus r3l0* minus trajectory_*
broadNonGate.note: The first clean broad non-gate runner exit 0 recorded in this line of stages. E4 and CI1 both carried an unresolved runner-exit defect; it did not reproduce here. One vitest forks-worker termination timeout was reported AFTER all 291 files and 3739 tests had passed and the process had already exited 0; it is recorded rather than omitted.

established: the delegated settlement route evaluates the Completion Contract it derives, between candidate export and the completion report, and records real evidence for every check that held
a legitimate delegated candidate reaches the product's own release gate and PASSES, with the gate's evidence_used naming exactly the three atoms the route recorded

every delegated atom names the candidate it was produced about (result_commit, candidate_tree, base_commit in the atom's open value map) and carries a content-addressed dependency_digest over (base, result, tree)
a write-scope violation, a missing required artifact, a failing standard command and an unobservable command each refuse the settlement and record no passing atom
evidence from one attempt does not satisfy a gate over another attempt, over another candidate, or over a commit subject
a repeated settlement converges: no second set of atoms, no second ATTEMPT_COMPLETED, no second head advance
two different candidates for one attempt are distinguished by dependency_digest and are NOT converged into one qualification
a qualified delegated candidate promotes through promoteWhenGatePasses, the head reconciles, and a dependent task is admitted with its frozen base equal to the promoted head
the Finish route's behaviour is unchanged: same atoms, same predicates, same values, same refusal behaviour
notEstablished: two real runtime subprocess Workers: the RuntimeCarrierPort and WorkWorkerRunPort remain test-owned, as the ruling permits; this is not a claim of live model-driven agents
L2 hostile same-user isolation: all execution is L1 cooperative
a cross-Owner dependency relation in the Trajectory vocabulary: CI1 found none exists and CI2 did not add one
crash recovery that survives a real process kill between export and evaluation: the windows were measured as re-derivability properties, not by killing a process mid-write
the full 279-file E4 selection reproducing its historical 3691 count: the selection is now 291 files because CI1 and CI2 added twelve
limitationsCarried: E3 quarantine residual TOCTOU is unchanged
module-sharing provenance is structural (paths and sizes), not content-addressed
rc.3 is qualified for the operations exercised, not every Win32 path
the real runtime Home content boundary remains unestablished
the stale deployment copy in the real runtime home is unchanged and still not on the executed path
